Practised counting sides and corners of 2D shapes.

end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides by following the outline from a starting point and stopping when returning to it. Ayaan correctly counted three triangle sides and four rectangle sides and corners; they were unsure about a picture showing only dots, then counted the four dots. At home, ask Ayaan to trace familiar shapes and count the sides and corners aloud, using calm prompts if they feel unsure.
